# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This batch of call transcripts is overwhelmingly **operational/logistics chatter** — vehicle (trailer/wagon) booking with transporters in Raipur/Nagpur/Tirupati/Vizag, driver coordination, MTC/TC/tag paperwork for QC departments (Uniqcore, Vinoth site), payment-release follow-ups, crane/loading status, and even a few prank/wrong-number and personal calls (Vishal, Veeramani). Only a **minority of calls are genuine sales conversations** — rate enquiries, quantity negotiations, stock checks, and dealer bargaining. These genuine sales calls are concentrated in a handful of recurring counter-parties: Tamilarasan Kumar, Thangaraj Metfra, V R Earth Movers, T Ravikumar (German Polymers), Vinayaga Steel Pradeep, Tirupati Balasubramaniam, Vidveda Krishnasamy, Uniqcore Balakrishnan, VJR Developers, Thirumala Steel Vizag, Yashil Mayurkumar Shah, Vasanth Narasimhan Engg, and a few one-off enquiries (Thirisha Enterprise, Utility Priya, Yuvaraj Elumalai).
